validate_config: validate a FastCSP configuration dictionary for required keys and nested parameters across workflow stages
reorder_stages_by_dependencies: reorder a list of FastCSP workflow stages to follow the correct canonical dependency order
review_validate_config: review the validate_config function to ensure all stage-specific required keys and nested keys are checked
refactor_validate_config: refactor validate_config to support additional workflow stages beyond generate, relax, filter, and evaluate
summarize_configuration_module: summarize the FastCSP configuration module that validates workflow parameters and reorders stage dependencies
